facts.statement: IFSCA Grade A Officer vacancies: 2022-23 recruitment had 20 General-stream posts (UR 10, OBC 5, SC 3, ST 1, EWS 1); 2024 had 10 posts (8 General including UR 3/OBC 3/SC 1/ST 1/EWS 2 plus 2 Legal); 2025 has 20 posts - 12 General (UR 4/OBC 3/SC 2/ST 1/EWS 2), 4 Legal (UR 2/OBC 1) and 4 IT (UR 2/OBC 1/ST 1).

IFSCA Grade A eligibility (consistent across notifications): age limit 30 years with relaxations SC/ST +5, OBC +3, PwBD +10, Ex-servicemen +5; General-stream education: Master's degree in Statistics, Economics, Commerce or MBA (Finance)/Econometrics, OR Bachelor's in IT/CS or MCA, OR B.Com with CA/CFA/CS/ICWA, OR Bachelor of Law; minimum 60% marks (55% for SC/ST). Application fee Rs 1,000 (GEN/EWS/OBC) and Rs 100 (SC/ST/PwBD).

Selection: Phase I is screening only (marks not counted for final selection); final merit is Phase II 85% plus Interview 15%; candidates are shortlisted for interview at 3 times the vacancies; in 2025 the IT stream must pass a qualifying coding test after Phase II before interview eligibility.

IFSCA cutoffs: 2023 Phase II interview shortlist - SC 54.67, ST 54.67, OBC 59.33, EWS 59.67, UR 59.67. 2024-25 cycle (Phase II exam 13 October 2024, interviews 16-18 December, final result 23 December 2024): Phase II cutoffs SC 60.34, ST 57.66, OBC 68.00, EWS 62.33, UR 69.66, PwBD-DHH 43.00, PwBD-LD 61.00; final cutoffs SC 62.75, ST 56.96, OBC 68.50, EWS 63.53, UR 72.44; Legal stream final UR 74.82 (UR only selected). 15 candidates were selected (UR 6, OBC 4, EWS 2, SC 2, ST 1).

IFSCA Grade A Officer pay scale: Rs 62,500 - 3600(4) - 76,900 - 4050(7) - 1,05,250 - EB - 4050(4) - 1,21,450 - 4650(1) - 1,26,100 over 17 years, with approximate gross of Rs 1,80,000 per month at the minimum and probation of 2 years.

2024-25 General stream interview-mark ranges: weighted Phase II scores roughly 43.00 to 75.33 out of 100; interview scores 34 to 77; final totals 56.16 to 74.43. Legal stream: Phase II scores 81-93 with final totals 72.20-78.07.
